name: models
role: the owner of a small project on your own computer; nobody else has set anything up for you
goal: I want to find out which model reads images (OCR) and which makes embeddings, and change the OCR model.
note: Models walk (2026-11-13): /model opens the roles window; enter picks a role's model, x resets it, esc closes; /model use completes.

steps.promise: The first screen tells me what dun needs from me before it can help.
I can sign in with what my colleague gave me and pick a model.

actions.wait_for: log in to an AI service

actions.say: picked custom: my colleague gave me an address

steps.promise: I can see which model does each job, including images and embeddings.
I can move to the image-reading role and see what it does.
Enter shows me the models I can give that role.
After I choose, I am back at the roles window and it shows my new image model.
I can put the embeddings role back to its default with one key.
Esc closes the window and I am back at my input.
Typing /model use shows me what can come next.
